description:
Thanks to NTE for sponsoring this video. NTE: Neverness to Everness version 1.3 is out now, introducing a new villain, Zankou, a massive map expansion with the Duskmoor district, new watersports and racing activities, all accessible with cross-platform progress. Find out more: pwgam.es/4wKsGAj

This one's late as we had no access to the game pre-launch - and there's a lot to cover. In this video, we look at Game Freak's first action RPG and its debut outing on Unreal Engine 5. There's lots to go through here as we cover multiple modes on each console, along with PC analysis and optimised settings.
